story.title: Iran Demands US Compliance Before Reopening Strait of Hormuz
story.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States meets their demands, which include compensation for war damages and an end to sanctions. This blockade has caused market instability and rising energy prices.

timeline_highlights.title: Iran Claims Attacks on US Bases in Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait Amid Escalating Conflict
timeline_highlights.summary: Iran's military announced it targeted US military bases in Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait in retaliation for recent US strikes on Iran. The Iranian Revolutionary Guards reportedly aimed at a data center in Bahrain linked to Amazon. This escalation follows a vow from the US for 'major military punishment' against Tehran and its allies.

related_stories.summary: Mohsen Rezaei, a former commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), has been appointed as the secretary of Iran's top security body. This move is seen as a sign of the Iranian establishment consolidating power, particularly in the context of ongoing discussions regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

related_stories.title: Syria Regains Control of Key Mediterranean Bases from Russia
related_stories.summary: Syria and Russia have reached an agreement that allows Syria to regain control of two strategic Mediterranean bases: the Hmeimem air base and part of Tartous port. The deal, announced by Syria's foreign ministry, stipulates that the remaining military facilities will be transformed into joint training centers.

related_stories.title: Deadly Ukrainian Drone Attack in Russia Claims 13 Lives
related_stories.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack on the industrial city of Nizhnekamsk in Tatarstan has resulted in at least 13 fatalities and numerous injuries. This incident marks one of the deadliest strikes on Russian territory since the onset of the conflict. Reports indicate that the attack targeted industrial and civilian sites, with local authorities confirming the casualties and injuries.

related_stories.title: Typhoon Dolphin Triggers Mass Evacuations in Eastern China
related_stories.summary: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall in eastern China, prompting the evacuation of over one million residents. The storm has brought heavy rain and strong winds, leading to significant disruptions, including the cancellation of nearly 1,000 flights in Shanghai. Authorities have issued top-level alerts as the storm is expected to move further inland in the coming days.
